After reaching [[Combat]] level 10:{{Name|Iridium Ore|1%}}{{Name|Iridium Ore|1%}}{{Name|Prismatic Shard|0.1%}} }} '''Wilderness Golems''' are a unique [[Monsters|enemy]] found on farms at night if the player selects the [[Farm Maps|wilderness map]] as the farm layout. They'll scale in difficulty based on the player's [[combat]] level; as the player's level increases so will the monster's difficulty. Wilderness Golems can also spawn on other farm layouts provided the player has given a [[Strange Bun]] to the Dark Shrine of Night Terrors in the [[Witch's Hut]], or chosen the [[Options|Advanced Option]] "Spawn monsters on the farm" at new game creation. ==Behavior== They come out of the ground and wander aimlessly and slowly make their way to the player, damaging the player if they collide. Their behavior is the same as [[Stone Golem]]s. ==Strategy== Swinging at them with a sword is the most effective strategy. ==Trivia== A Wilderness Golem plays a central role in [[Abigail]]'s 14 heart event. ==References== Rice Shoots are added to Wilderness Golem drops by RockGolem::getExtraDropItems, only in Spring. The value specified in Data/Monsters.xnb is 5XP. However, monsters killed on [[the Farm]] give 1/3 of the normal XP value, which is then truncated. So Wilderness Golems on the farm grant 1XP.
